Name: Natural Meteor
Author: Vaelka
Description:
[size=5]Description[/size]
This is just a quick recolor for the default meteor, if you're like me and the purple doesn't quite match your farm's color scheme.
Tested on mac.

Note: I'm primarily a Skyrim modder, please let me know if anything is amiss.
Recolor in screenshots: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
